design.control: 5 unflagged eligible players of the same family, role, date and baseline game-SD tercile, drawn without replacement with a seed per flag, scored with the flag's threshold in the flag's direction against their own flag-date baseline
design.dates: the calibration's Sundays from the third Sunday of May through the last one at least 30 days before the season's last game
design.flag: trend_detect at HEAD as of D at the frozen bar and the family's floor, the season's shrink fit and placebo SD from the lab's earlier-season tables
design.hit: the trait over the 30 days after the flag date, net of the league drift of every eligible player of the same role over those days, differs from the flag-date baseline in the flagged direction (sign of d) by at least half the flagged raw change (|raw|); no eligible game in those days is no hit
design.metric: hit rate of the episodes against the hit rate of their controls; the gap's 95 percent interval with players resampled whole; one-sided p the share of replicates with a gap at or below zero
design.mix_trait: the plain pooled share of the pitch family the flag selected, against the baseline's pooled share
design.verdict: Holm across the registered families at 0.05 one-sided (a family with no episode at p = 1); PASS when the gap clears Holm and the hit rate is 0.5 or more; FAIL at 40 or more episodes otherwise; INDETERMINATE under 40

mix.label: Pitch-family mix, last 3 starts or 8 outings

lines.bat_speed: Of the changes like this listed in 2021 to 2025, 70 percent were still at least half as large 30 days later (players with no listed change: 10 percent)
lines.mix: Of the changes like this listed in 2021 to 2025, 70 percent were still at least half as large 30 days later (players with no listed change: 4 percent)
lines.rp_hb: Of the changes like this listed in 2021 to 2025, 68 percent were still at least half as large 30 days later (players with no listed change: 8 percent)
lines.rp_spin: Of the changes like this listed in 2021 to 2025, 73 percent were still at least half as large 30 days later (players with no listed change: 7 percent)

what: League Trends' registered persistence read: per family at its frozen bar, the share of listed changes (episodes) whose trait, net of league drift, is still at least half as large over the 30 days after the flag, against 5 matched unflagged players per flag; the gap with players resampled whole and Holm across families.
